name: Breeze — cigarette no-smoking
concept: A single oversized cigarette laid as the unmistakable hero across a calm teal field: thick ivory body, an amber/tan filter band, and a live ember tip (dark charred edge over a hot orange-red glow). A bold red diagonal slash cuts across the cigarette as the secondary "no" gesture — a thick bar, not a round prohibition ring — so the icon reads as "quit cigarettes," not a generic prohibited sign. Big silhouette, limited palette, one gradient on the ember only, all clearly legible at 60px.
palette: Calm teal background (#0E7C7B → #0A5C5E), ivory cigarette body (#F6F1E7) with tan shadow (#E4D9C3), amber filter (#D99A3C / #B9792A), charred tip (#2A2622) with hot ember glow (#FF6A2C → #C42E12), bold prohibition red slash (#E11D2E)

name: Breeze — Clear the Air
concept: One large, crisp ivory cigarette lies on a strong diagonal as the hero, its warm ember glowing at the top. A bold red no-smoking ring with a thick slash sits in the lower-left, crossing only the filter end so the cigarette's body stays fully readable. Deep teal-to-charcoal ground gives premium contrast and nods to "Breeze". Filled, geometric, one gradient — reads instantly at 60px.
palette: Deep teal-charcoal ground (#0E2A33 → #07171C), ivory cigarette paper (#F7F3E8), warm tan filter (#D9A867), glowing ember (#FF7A2F → #FFD24A), bold prohibition red (#FF3B30 / #E12B22).

_issues: No-smoking ring/slash sit over the glowing ember hero tip (ring center 60px from ember), not the filter as intended — muddies the focal point at 60px; plus invalid hex #16soon in bg.

name: Breeze — Crushed Out
concept: One bold, filled cigarette laid across the icon with a single sharp V-bend at its center — the universal "crushed / stubbed out" gesture. The far-left end wears a thick orange filter band; the far-right end is a flat, dark, snuffed tip (no ember, no smoke), reading as extinguished. Exactly three shape groups on a deep premium teal gradient give strong contrast and a clean silhouette that survives down to 60px. The bend does all the storytelling — quitting smoking, broken habit — with zero clutter, no ashtray, no fragments.
palette: Teal gradient background #23C3D8 → #0B5E79 (calm, premium, "breeze"); crisp white cigarette body #FFFFFF for max contrast; warm orange filter accent #FF7C33; deep snuffed-tip ink #0A3A48.

name: Clean Break
concept: A single cigarette snapped cleanly in two: a long ivory paper body half on the left and a shorter amber filter half on the right, pulled apart with an obvious gap and matching jagged tear edges facing each other. The two halves are vertically offset across the break line so the eye instantly reads "snapped, not whole." Laid on a calm deep-teal-to-petrol gradient that signals the Breeze/Бриз brand — fresh air, premium, recovery. One focal idea, bold filled shapes, high contrast, readable at 60px.
palette: Ivory body #F6EFDD with white top-light; amber filter #EFA743 with cork-orange tear edge #C97E2E; break shadows in low-opacity black; background gradient teal #17C0AD → #0E8E8E → petrol #075763.

name: Breeze — Fresh Lungs
concept: Two healthy lung lobes as one bold, symmetrical filled silhouette, joined by a central airway (trachea splitting into bronchi). The white-to-mint lungs sit on a deep teal-to-sky breath gradient — clean, premium, unmistakably "healthy lungs." Reads instantly at 60px: clear lobes left/right, vertical airway down the middle.
palette: Deep teal #0B6E63 to fresh sky #19C3A4 background; lungs in soft white #FFFFFF to mint #DFF7EF; airway accent in the same mint.

name: Breeze — Lungs Exhaling Fresh Air
concept: A bold, solid pair of lungs (two lobes joined by a central airway) exhaling a single solid, symmetric puff of fresh air directly above. One connected breathing idea: the body clearing out, fresh air rising. High-contrast white forms on a calm teal-to-deep-cyan gradient that evokes clean air and breath ("Breeze"). No literal cigarette imagery — wellness-positive, premium, and instantly readable at 60px as "fresh breath + healthy lungs." No thin tapering tails, no comma/worm swoosh shapes: every element is a filled, deliberate solid.
palette: White (#FFFFFF) focal shapes on a single vertical teal gradient from bright aqua (#34CDCF) to deep cyan (#09617F). Limited, deliberate, high-contrast — one tasteful gradient only, used for the background.
_issues: Top "puff" reads as a flat-bottomed cloud/brain, disconnected from lungs; big empty gap breaks the single breathing idea; two ambiguous blobs at 60px.

name: Breeze
concept: A single bold two-leaf sprout rising from a stem — the universal symbol of fresh starts and new growth, signaling life returning after quitting smoking. Two symmetrical filled leaves unfurl from a central vertical stem, all in clean white against a fresh emerald gradient. The symmetry and rounded stem read as calm and premium, not clinical. Deliberately leaf-only with no horizontal element anywhere, so it can never be mistaken for a medical cross.
palette: Fresh emerald gradient background (#34D399 mint → #10B981 emerald → #047857 deep pine) with a crisp white-to-mint sprout (#FFFFFF → #E7FBF1). Single tasteful gradient, high contrast, alive and clean.

name: Breeze — Rising Air
concept: A bold abstract breath-and-freedom mark: a thick solid crescent at the base reads as a calm exhale opening up, and a single confident upward chevron of "air" lifts out of it — the feeling of a clean breath and release from smoking. Built entirely from solid filled forms, no thin spirals or worm strokes. Full-bleed calm sky gradient (deep teal to fresh aqua) evokes fresh air and breathing room; the crisp off-white forms give a premium, geometric, high-contrast silhouette readable at 60px.
palette: Deep teal-blue #0B4F66 to fresh aqua #19C2B6 (single background gradient); crisp off-white #F4FBFB forms; subtle aqua-tint shadow for depth
